data.body: Cross-epic note (config epic unhygienic-houndlike-arrowworm, story S2): that story adds `_LLM_KNOWN_KEYS` (the tuple of keys the reserved `[llm]` table accepts) with an unknown-key warning, and its test `test_llm_known_keys_match_config_readers` carries a `{"evals"}` carve-out so that this story's new `[llm.evals] corpus_root` reader does not fail it. Landing rule for this story: if the config story has already landed, add `"evals"` to `_LLM_KNOWN_KEYS` and delete the `{"evals"}` carve-out in that test in this change; if this story lands first, do nothing here and the config story includes `"evals"` directly (it reads the live `config_readers.py`). The reader is added in `src/rebar/llm/config_readers.py`, never in `_config_schema.py`.
